primarySkillTexts.诛害: 其他角色的结束阶段，若其本回合造成过伤害，你可以对其使用一张【杀】。
primarySkillTexts.潜心: 觉醒技，当你造成伤害后，若你已受伤，你减少1点体力上限并获得“荐言”。

linkedSkillSourceGap.resolverStatus: No skill resolver found in the page or its linked heroDetail.js, commen.js and header.js; the 707 link was not successfully resolved.
linkedSkillSourceGap.implementationBasis: The current page verifies the two printed skills. Jianyan is selected from official supplemental material with the same pre-breakthrough Zhuhai and Qianxin wording. This is a derived text choice, not a claim that the current 304 page supplied Jianyan in full.

supports: Zhuhai can use Slash at a distant ending-turn target
Jianyan selects a card category or color
Unmatched revealed cards go into discard without being discarded

supplementalSources.edition: Ten-Year Anniversary update, BEFORE-breakthrough column only
supports: Full Jianyan wording for the same printed Zhuhai/Qianxin pair
supplementalSources.selectedText: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以声明一种牌的类别或颜色，然后将牌库中第一张符合你声明的牌交给一名男性角色。
supplementalSources.excluded: The AFTER-breakthrough Zhuhai Slash/Dismantle conversion and Jianyan per-item limits belong to the enhanced Ten-Year Anniversary line and are not imported.

selectedJianyanText: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以声明一种牌的类别或颜色，然后将牌库中第一张符合你声明的牌交给一名男性角色。

supplementaryInterpretations.zhuhaiDistanceBasis: Official 2016 ordinary-OL strategy guidance supplements the omission of a distance clause in current hero/304; presentation retains hero/304 verbatim.
supplementaryInterpretations.recipient: Any currently living male character, including self; CharacterState.Gender applies live override/avatar gender.
supplementaryInterpretations.unmatchedMovement: DrawPile to DiscardPile with program.declared-deck.unmatched, outside discard-action triggers.

engineeringDefaults.emptyInitialDeck: Use the existing empty-only reshuffle once before searching.
engineeringDefaults.searchCap: Freeze the initial draw-pile count after that refill; every real top-card revelation consumes one slot. Re-read the current top after movement children. Do not refill mid-search; absent criteria terminate finitely.
engineeringDefaults.matchedCard: Hold the first matching physical entity publicly in Processing; let movement children finish before publishing the male-recipient choice.
engineeringDefaults.lostSourceOrNoMale: The owning frame cancels or completes and cleans its bound Processing card into DiscardPile without selecting a replacement private card.
engineeringDefaults.jianyanQuota: Once per actual play phase, without importing the later per-item enhancement.
engineeringDefaults.awakening: Mandatory once per game after actual source damage while wounded; reduce maximum HP then grant the chosen Jianyan skill.
engineeringDefaults.ai: Price only public opportunity; choose trick deterministically without deck inspection, then self if currently male. Fixed-target Slash chooses a legal owned payment before a faction request.
